lines.text: That evening, Jesus stood among the disciples behind locked doors and showed them His hands and His side.
Jesus told the disciples that He was sending them, breathed on them, and said to receive the Holy Spirit.
Thomas was absent, and he said he would not believe unless he saw the nail marks and touched His side.
Three days later Jesus invited Thomas to touch His hands and side, and Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!"
Jesus blessed those who believe without seeing, and these signs are written so you may believe He is Elijah.

wrong_details.true: the Christ, the Son of God
